devdoc.details: Provides functions for adding, removing, and retrieving assets, along with managing fees.

params.arrayLength: The length of the array that caused the error.

params.annualFeePercent: The incorrect annual percentage fee provided.

params.depositFees: The incorrect deposit fee percentage provided.

params.withdrawalFees: The incorrect withdrawal fee percentage provided.

NewOwnerIsZeroAddress().details: The `newOwner` cannot be the zero address.

NoHandoverRequest().details: The `pendingOwner` does not have a valid handover request.

Unauthorized().details: The caller is not authorized to call the function.

params.bundle: The address of the asset's bundle.
params.newAsset: The address of the newly added asset.

params.asset: The address of the removed asset.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized.

params.newMaxArraySize: The new maximum array size allowed.

OwnershipHandoverCanceled(address).details: The ownership handover to `pendingOwner` has been canceled.

OwnershipHandoverRequested(address).details: An ownership handover to `pendingOwner` has been requested.

OwnershipTransferred(address,address).details: The ownership is transferred from `oldOwner` to `newOwner`. This event is intentionally kept the same as OpenZeppelin's Ownable to be compatible with indexers and [EIP-173](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-173), despite it not being as lightweight as a single argument event.

params.newPercentage: The new percentage value for dissolution.

addAssetsBundle(address[],address[]).details: Only the contract owner can call this function. The number of assets should not exceed `maxArraySize`.

params.assets: An array of new asset addresses to be added.
params.bundles: Corresponding asset information for each asset.

cancelOwnershipHandover().details: Cancels the two-step ownership handover to the caller, if any.

changeDissolvePercentage(uint256).details: Only the contract owner can modify this value.

changeMaxArraySize(uint256).details: Only callable by the contract owner.

params.newMaxArraySize: The new maximum number of assets allowed.

completeOwnershipHandover(address).details: Allows the owner to complete the two-step ownership handover to `pendingOwner`. Reverts if there is no existing ownership handover requested by `pendingOwner`.

returns._0: The percentage to dissolve a bundle.
The address of the fee receiver.

feesSetUp(address,uint256,uint256,uint25.details: Only the owner can change the fees.

params._depositFeePercent: New deposit fee percentage (in basis points).
params._feeReceiver: Address where collected fees will be sent.
params._withdrawalFeePercent: New withdrawal fee percentage (in basis points).

initialize(address).details: Can only be called once, during contract deployment.

params._owner: The address of the contract owner.

owner().details: Returns the owner of the contract.

ownershipHandoverExpiresAt(address).details: Returns the expiry timestamp for the two-step ownership handover to `pendingOwner`.

removeAssetBundle(address).details: Only callable by the contract owner.

params.assetAddress: The address of the asset to be removed.

renounceOwnership().details: Allows the owner to renounce their ownership.

requestOwnershipHandover().details: Request a two-step ownership handover to the caller. The request will automatically expire in 48 hours (172800 seconds) by default.

transferOwnership(address).details: Allows the owner to transfer the ownership to `newOwner`.

ArraySizeError(uint256).notice: Error thrown when the size of an array is invalid.

ArraySizesDifferent().notice: Error thrown when two arrays have different sizes.

IncorrectAnnualFeePercentAmount(uint256).notice: Error thrown when an incorrect annual percentage fee amount is provided.

IncorrectDepositFeesAmount(uint256).notice: Error thrown when an incorrect deposit fee amount is provided.

IncorrectWithdrawalFeesAmount(uint256).notice: Error thrown when an incorrect withdrawal fee amount is provided.

PercentageCannotExceed100().notice: Error thrown when an incorrect withdrawal fee amount is provided.

ZeroAmountPassed().notice: Error thrown when the provided amount is 0.

AssetAdded(address,address).notice: Emitted when a new asset is added.

AssetRemoved(address).notice: Emitted when an asset is removed.

MaxArraySizeChanged(uint256).notice: Emitted when the maximum array size is updated.

PercentageToDissolveChanged(uint256).notice: Emitted when the percentage to dissolve the bundle is changed.

addAssetsBundle(address[],address[]).notice: Adds new assets to the storage.

annualFeePercent().notice: Retrieves the current annual percentage fee.

assetsBundle(address).notice: Mapping of asset addresses to their corresponding asset information.

changeDissolvePercentage(uint256).notice: Updates the percentage required to dissolve a bundle.

changeMaxArraySize(uint256).notice: Sets a new maximum size for the asset array.

depositFeePercent().notice: Retrieves the current deposit fee percentage.

dissolvePercentage().notice: Retrieves the current percentage to dissolve a bundle.

feeReceiver().notice: Retrieves the current fee receiver address.

feesSetUp(address,uint256,uint256,uint25.notice: Updates the fees structure for the contract.

initialize(address).notice: Initializes the contract with an owner.

removeAssetBundle(address).notice: Removes an asset from the storage.

withdrawalFeePercent().notice: Retrieves the current withdrawal fee percentage.

userdoc.notice: This contract manages the storage and handling bundle assets and their associated fees.
